# telnyx_call_control_applications (Data Source)

Lists call control applications, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_call_control_application`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_application_name_contains` (String) If present, applications with <code>application_name</code> containing the given value will be returned. Matching is not case-sensitive. Requires at least three characters.
- `filter_application_session_id` (String) The unique identifier of the call session. A session may include multiple call leg events.
- `filter_connection_id` (String) The unique identifier of the conection.
- `filter_failed` (Boolean) Delivery failed or not.
- `filter_from` (String) Filter by From number.
- `filter_leg_id` (String) The unique identifier of an individual call leg.
- `filter_name` (String) If present, conferences will be filtered to those with a matching `name` attribute. Matching is case-sensitive
- `filter_occurred_at` (String) Event occurred_at: equal
- `filter_occurred_at_gt` (String) Event occurred_at: greater than
- `filter_occurred_at_gte` (String) Event occurred_at: greater than or equal
- `filter_occurred_at_lt` (String) Event occurred_at: lower than
- `filter_occurred_at_lte` (String) Event occurred_at: lower than or equal
- `filter_outbound_outbound_voice_profile_id` (String) Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.
- `filter_product` (String) Filter by product. One of `call_control`, `fax`, `texml`.
- `filter_status` (String) If present, conferences will be filtered by status. One of `completed`, `in_progress`, `init`.
- `filter_to` (String) Filter by To number.
- `filter_type` (String) Event type One of `command`, `webhook`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `active`, `connection_name`, `created_at`.

### Read-Only

- `call_control_applications` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--call_control_applications))

<a id="nestedatt--call_control_applications"></a>
### Nested Schema for `call_control_applications`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Specifies whether the connection can be used.
- `anchorsite_override` (String) <code>Latency</code> directs Telnyx to route media through the site with the lowest round-trip time to the user's connection. Telnyx calculates this time using ICMP ping messages. This can be disabled by specifying a site to handle all media.
- `application_name` (String) A user-assigned name to help manage the application.
- `call_cost_in_webhooks` (Boolean) Specifies if call cost webhooks should be sent for this Call Control Application.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was created
- `dtmf_type` (String) Sets the type of DTMF digits sent from Telnyx to this Connection. Note that DTMF digits sent to Telnyx will be accepted in all formats.
- `first_command_timeout` (Boolean) Specifies whether calls to phone numbers associated with this connection should hangup after timing out.
- `first_command_timeout_secs` (Number) Specifies how many seconds to wait before timing out a dial command.
- `id` (String)
- `inbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--call_control_applications--inbound))
- `outbound` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--call_control_applications--outbound))
- `record_type` (String)
- `redact_dtmf_debug_logging` (Boolean) When enabled, DTMF digits entered by users will be redacted in debug logs to protect PII data entered through IVR interactions.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags assigned to the Call Control Application.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date of when the resource was last updated
- `webhook_api_version` (String) Determines which webhook format will be used, Telnyx API v1 or v2.
- `webhook_event_failover_url` (String) The failover URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent if sending to the primary URL fails. Must include a scheme, such as `https`.
- `webhook_event_url` (String) The URL where webhooks related to this connection will be sent. Must include a scheme, such as `https`.
- `webhook_timeout_secs` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--call_control_applications--inbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `call_control_applications.inbound`

Read-Only:

- `channel_limit` (Number) When set, this will limit the total number of inbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.
- `shaken_stir_enabled` (Boolean) When enabled Telnyx will include Shaken/Stir data in the Webhook for new inbound calls.
- `sip_subdomain` (String) Specifies a subdomain that can be used to receive Inbound calls to a Connection, in the same way a phone number is used, from a SIP endpoint. Example: the subdomain "example.sip.telnyx.com" can be called from any SIP endpoint by using the SIP URI "sip:@example.sip.telnyx.com" where the user part can be any alphanumeric value. TLS signaling is supported. SRTP media encryption requires TLS transport.
- `sip_subdomain_receive_settings` (String) This option can be enabled to receive calls from: "Anyone" (any SIP endpoint in the public Internet) or "Only my connections" (any connection assigned to the same Telnyx user).


<a id="nestedatt--call_control_applications--outbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `call_control_applications.outbound`

Read-Only:

- `channel_limit` (Number) When set, this will limit the total number of outbound calls to phone numbers associated with this connection.
- `outbound_voice_profile_id` (String) Identifies the associated outbound voice profile.
